page_title: VAL 0-1 ALA | Valencia v Alaves 05/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' Diego Lopez (Valencia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
90+6' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Samu Omorodion (Alaves).
90+5' Sergi Canos (Valencia) horribly skewed a first-time shot from the edge of the box and sent the ball way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.

90+3' Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
90+3' Pepelu (Valencia) launches a cross from the corner, but Antonio Sivera is alert to thwart the effort.
90+2' Diego Lopez (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+1' Sergi Canos (Valencia) does well to connect with the resulting set piece, but his shot flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
89' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Carlos Vicente is replaced by Luis Rioja (Alaves).
89' Substitution. Jon Guridi leaves the pitch and is replaced by Alex Sola (Alaves).
88' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the corner which is cleared.

88' The opposing goalkeeper had set up the wall well before the free kick was executed and Pepelu (Valencia) failed to send the ball over. Great defensive action! The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Valencia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
87' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) makes a strong challenge and Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Valencia.
85' Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal.

83' A cross from the by-line finds Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
82' Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
80' Sergi Canos (Valencia) serves up a nice cross, but Antonio Sivera punches the ball away.
79' Sergi Canos (Valencia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
78' The main referee, Mario Melero Lopez, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Hugo Duro (Valencia) is given a yellow card for dissent.
77' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) will miss the next game.
77' Today's referee Mario Melero Lopez rightly decides to book Samu Omorodion (Alaves) for his harsh tackle.
76' Substitution. Peter Federico makes his way off the pitch and Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) comes on as his replacement.
76' Substitution. Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) on for Thierry Correia.
74' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Diego Lopez (Valencia) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
72' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to substitute Kike Garcia and he is replaced by Samu Omorodion (Alaves).
72' It will be a substitution. Ander Guevara (Alaves) is ready to enter the pitch as Antonio Blanco walks off.
71' Peter Federico (Valencia) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
70' The attendance is 44643.

68' 0 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Carlos Vicente delivers the corner, Javi Lopez (Alaves) finds himself some space on the edge of the box to unleash an unstoppable shot. His effort goes into the bottom right corner and past the helpless goalkeeper. 0:1.
68' The ball is out of play. Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner.
67' Sergi Canos (Valencia) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Mario Melero Lopez stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
67' Pepelu (Valencia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
66' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Cenk Ozkacar.
64' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
64' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Alaves get a corner.
63' The ball is cleared after Diego Lopez (Valencia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
61' The resulting corner from Sergi Canos (Valencia) comes to nothing.
60' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
58' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

58' Javi Lopez (Alaves) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Alaves win a corner kick.

57' Kike Garcia (Alaves) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Jaume Domenech guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
56' A cross by Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
56' Pepelu (Valencia) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
55' Jon Guridi (Alaves) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
54' Problems for Luis Garcia Plaza as Andoni Gorosabel is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Rafa Marin (Alaves) replaces him.
52' Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Jaume Domenech easily deals with the threat.
50' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
49' Sergi Canos (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but Antonio Sivera comes off his line to gather the ball.
49' Diego Lopez (Valencia) takes the corner with a short pass.
48' Peter Federico (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Valencia.
46' Sergi Canos (Valencia) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
46' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Sergi Canos comes on the pitch for Andre Almeida (Valencia).
46' The whistle blows and Mario Melero Lopez starts the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mario Melero Lopez no option but to blow his whistle.
45+2' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45+1' Andre Almeida (Valencia) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
45' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
44' Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
43' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
42' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
41' Javi Lopez (Alaves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
39' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jaume Domenech intercepts the ball.
37' Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) commits a foul and Mario Melero Lopez immediately signals a free kick.
36' Diego Lopez (Valencia) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
34' Jaume Domenech (Valencia) is being substituted because of an injury. Ruben Baraja sends Cristian Rivero on the pitch.
33' Jaume Domenech (Valencia) picks up an injury.
32' The foul by Kike Garcia (Alaves) was seen by Mario Melero Lopez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
30' A crossfield pass from Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.

29' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
27' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) makes a slide tackle, but referee Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul. Valencia have a free kick.
26' Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
24' Pepelu (Valencia) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
23' Pepelu (Valencia) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
22' A yellow card for a tackle by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves). Mario Melero Lopez doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
20' The corner from Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is cleared away by the defence.
20' Kike Garcia (Alaves) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper.
19' Hugo Duro (Valencia) forces a pass into the box, but Antonio Sivera is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
16' A cross from Kike Garcia (Alaves) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
14' Diego Lopez (Valencia) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
13' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
11' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) gets booked for the first time in this match.
11' Javi Guerra (Valencia) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the middle of the goal, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Antonio Sivera. What a save!
10' Diego Lopez (Valencia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
9' The free kick into the penalty area from Pepelu (Valencia) is cleared.
7' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Javi Lopez (Alaves).
7' Kike Garcia (Alaves) leaps high to meet a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but his header rattles the left post!

6' Andre Almeida (Valencia) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
4' Jaume Domenech (Valencia) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
2' The game is interrupted now, Jaume Domenech (Valencia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
1' The first half has just begun.
